item.title: Oracle Identity Manager `;.wadl` Authentication Bypass + Groovy Script RCE (CVE-2025-61757)
item.description:
Metadata

Tags oracle, identity-manager, oim, authentication-bypass, rce, groovy, wadl, security-filter, cwe-287, cwe-94
Related N/A

Affected Target

Field Value
Software / System Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) — applicationmanagement REST API
Versions Affected Oracle Identity Manager instances exposing the /iam/governance/applicationmanagement/api/v1/applications/groovyscriptstatus endpoint (unpatched)
Language / Platform Java / WebLogic-hosted REST API, Groovy scripting engine
Authentication Required None (bypassed)
Network Access Required Yes (HTTP/HTTPS access to the OIM management port, typically 7001)

Summary

Oracle Identity Manager’s SecurityFilter fails to correctly normalize request URIs before applying its authentication check. By appending a ;.wadl matrix-parameter suffix to the path of the groovyscriptstatus endpoint, an unauthenticated attacker can bypass SecurityFilter entirely and reach the underlying servlet directly. That servlet accepts a JSON body containing a script field and a compile: true flag, compiles the supplied Groovy source, and executes it server-side — because Groovy’s String.execute() spawns an OS process, this yields unauthenticated remote code execution as the OIM/WebLogic service account.
